name: safe-refactor
description: Find the highest-value behavior-preserving refactor that can be safely bounded, covered by tests or equivalent evidence, and validated.

interface.shortDescription: High-value safe refactors with evidence first
interface.longDescription: Find the highest-value architecture or code-quality refactor that can be safely bounded, protect current behavior through tests or equivalent evidence, preserve backward compatibility, and report validation plus residual risk.
defaultPrompt: Use $safe-refactor to find the highest-value safe refactor and preserve behavior.
Use $safe-refactor in this repo and preserve public API compatibility.
Find a meaningful refactor opportunity, protect existing behavior, and validate it.
